rows.label: Official ad valorem tax rate for the Property A tax rate area (TRA)
rows.note: Santa Clara County has no single rate; it is 1% Prop 13 base + a countywide retirement levy + voter-approved debt that varies by TRA. The official per-TRA Compilation of Tax Rates could not be retrieved from the county site during this pass. Rate-dependent projections on this site therefore use the rate implied by the owner's own 2025 bill, and that substitution is flagged.
